description: Live-check 1-10 URLs against Google's URL Inspection API: indexing verdict, coverage state, last crawl time, and Google's chosen canonical. Requires a connected Search Console property that covers the URLs. Results are cached onto matching published articles.

project_id.description: MotiBlog project id permitted by the current credential. Omit when a default project is configured.

urls.description: Absolute URLs to inspect (1-10), each within the connected property

name: inspect_urls
title: Inspect URLs
